payload.title: forgot password link is visible on the login form
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toBeVisible()

Locator: getByTestId('forgot-password-link')
Expected: visible
Received: <element(s) not found>

note: A 10-second timeout waiting for visibility is the textbook flaky shape. But zero prior failures in 45 runs plus an identical 'not found' (not 'found but hidden') on both attempts point to a recent auth redesign renaming the test-id from forgot-password-link to password-reset-link, not a rendering delay. A flake would eventually pass on retry against the same locator; this one fails the same way every time.
